name: G10S
note: 2.4G Composite receiver - mic shows up as MIC-Wireless Device. Layout traced from product photos

steps.title: Voice (mic) - hold 3 seconds
steps.instruction: The red microphone key in the middle, between PAGE and VOL. Press and HOLD it, count 1-2-3, then release.

steps.title: Voice (mic) - quick tap
steps.instruction: Tap the same microphone key once, quickly.

steps.title: Home / Back
steps.instruction: The key under the ring on the left, with the house and return-arrow icons. Hold ~2 seconds, then release.

steps.title: Play / Pause
steps.instruction: Second row, left. Hold ~1 second, then release.

steps.title: Mouse on/off
steps.instruction: Second row, right. Hold ~1 second, release (press again if the pointer stops).

steps.title: OK
steps.instruction: The centre of the orange ring. Hold ~1 second, then release.

steps.title: Menu
steps.instruction: The key under the ring on the right (three lines). Hold ~1 second, then release.

steps.title: PAGE up
steps.instruction: Top half of the PAGE key. Hold ~1 second, then release.

steps.title: PAGE down
steps.instruction: Bottom half of the PAGE key. Hold ~1 second, then release.

steps.title: VOL +
steps.instruction: Top half of the VOL key. Hold ~1 second, then release.

steps.title: VOL -
steps.instruction: Bottom half of the VOL key. Hold ~1 second, then release.

steps.title: DEL
steps.instruction: Bottom-left key. Hold ~1 second, then release.

steps.title: Mute
steps.instruction: Bottom-right key. Hold ~1 second, release (press again afterwards to unmute).

steps.title: Power (optional)
steps.instruction: WARNING: this may put the PC to sleep or open the shutdown menu. Press Space to skip unless you want to map it.
